evening.caption:
Season caught one golden ray, and the whole sky opened up ☀️

Season is the bright Yang spirit, and when that sunlight reached him he became Yang Fire: the sun itself. Bing Fire doesn't flicker quietly like a candle. It shines on everyone at once, warm, generous and impossible to miss, and it chases the grey days away. In people, it is the open, enthusiastic, big-hearted side that lights up a room, lifts the mood and makes sure everyone feels included. Like the sun, it gives its warmth without asking for anything back.

Who is the sunshine in your life, the one who brightens every room they walk into? Tag them below 👇
